email.subject: Exclusive Discount on Office Coffee Supplies!
email.body:
Hi there,

Are you looking to upgrade your office coffee beans? We offer 30% off our premium espresso blend for commercial offices in downtown Boston. Order now before Friday!

Best regards,
Office Cafe Rep

expected_behavior.scenario: Unrelated spam/sales email that is not an RFP or proposal request
expected_behavior.anti_hallucination_requirement: AI must NOT fabricate a commercial IT proposal for coffee supplies.
